queries.counts: select (select count(*) from public.indicator_series) series,(select count(*) from public.indicator_values) value_rows,(select count(*) from public.items) items,(select count(*) from public.atlas_mechanism_cases) cases,(select count(*) from public.atlas_mechanisms) mechanisms,(select count(*) from public.atlas_themes) themes,(select count(*) from (select distinct series_key,group_key from public.indicator_values)g) series_groups
queries.profile: select value_kind,validation_status,is_published,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where value is null) null_numeric,min(year) first_year,max(year) last_year from public.indicator_values group by value_kind,validation_status,is_published order by n desc
queries.meta_keys: select k,count(*) series from public.indicator_series s cross join lateral jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(metadata,'{}')) k group by k order by series desc
queries.research: select 'models' kind,to_jsonb(m) data from research.impact_model m union all select 'bindings',to_jsonb(b) from research.impact_input_binding b union all select 'runs',jsonb_build_object('model_key',model_key,'baseline_year',baseline_year,'runs',count(*)) from research.impact_model_run group by model_key,baseline_year
queries.research_counts: select 'observations' kind,count(*) n from research.observation union all select 'derived_values',count(*) from research.derived_value union all select 'source_locators',count(*) from research.source_locator union all select 'computations',count(*) from research.computation union all select 'computation_runs',count(*) from research.computation_run union all select 'visual_points',count(*) from research.impact_visual_point union all select 'legal_statutes',count(*) from lakikartta.statutes
queries.simulation: select to_jsonb(p) data from public.simulation_normalization_params p
queries.sim_effects: select evidence_status,relationship_type,include_in_composite,count(*) n from public.simulation_statute_effects group by evidence_status,relationship_type,include_in_composite
queries.themes: select t.id,t.payload->>'name' name,t.payload->>'scores_basis' scores_basis,t.payload->'scores' editorial_scores,count(distinct tv.variable_id) linked_variables,count(distinct vi.series_key) linked_series from public.atlas_themes t left join public.atlas_theme_variables tv on tv.theme_id=t.id left join public.atlas_variable_indicators vi on vi.variable_id=tv.variable_id group by t.id,t.payload order by t.id
queries.model_spans: select model_key,baseline_year,count(*) points,min(year) first_year,max(year) last_year,array_agg(distinct value_status) statuses,count(distinct release_id) releases from research.impact_visual_point group by model_key,baseline_year order by model_key,baseline_year
queries.legal_counts: select 'statute_catalog' family,count(*) n from lakikartta.statute_catalog union all select 'statutes_core',count(*) from lakikartta.statutes_core union all select 'historical_legal_events',count(*) from lakikartta.historical_legal_events union all select 'ministerial_appointments',count(*) from lakikartta.ministerial_appointments union all select 'historical_office_terms',count(*) from lakikartta.historical_office_terms union all select 'state_enterprises',count(*) from lakikartta.state_enterprises union all select 'state_enterprise_events',count(*) from lakikartta.state_enterprise_events union all select 'public_finance_observations',count(*) from public.public_finance_observations
queries.case_summary: select kind,status,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where jsonb_typeof(data->'numeric_effect')='number') numeric_effects,count(*) filter(where coalesce(data->>'causal_effect_identified','false')='true') causal_effect_identified,min(year_start) first_year,max(year_end) last_year from public.atlas_mechanism_cases group by kind,status
queries.item_summary: select type,subtype,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where sources is null or cardinality(sources)=0) no_sources,count(*) filter(where year_start is null) no_year from public.items group by type,subtype
queries.other_series: select s.*,count(v.*) value_rows,min(v.year) first_year,max(v.year) last_year from public.statistic_series s left join public.statistic_values v on v.series_code=s.code group by s.code
queries.research_values: select value_status,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where uncertainty_low is not null or uncertainty_high is not null) uncertainty_rows from research.derived_value where retracted_at is null group by value_status
queries.normalization_check: select p.series_key,p.normalization_method,p.methodology_version,exists(select 1 from public.indicator_series s where s.series_key=p.series_key) known_series,count(b.*) baseline_rows,min(b.year) first_year,max(b.year) last_year,array_agg(distinct b.value_kind) baseline_kinds from public.simulation_normalization_params p left join public.simulation_indicator_baselines b using(series_key) group by p.series_key,p.normalization_method,p.methodology_version
queries.finance_schema: select table_name,string_agg(column_name,', ' order by ordinal_position) columns from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name like 'public_finance%' group by table_name
queries.finance_profile: select value_kind,validation_status,release_status,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where value is null) null_numeric,min(year) first_year,max(year) last_year,count(distinct series_key) series from public.public_finance_observations group by value_kind,validation_status,release_status order by n desc
queries.model_computed: select model_key,baseline_year,count(*) filter(where value_status='computed') computed_points,count(*) filter(where value_status='not_computable') missing_points,min(year) filter(where value_status='computed') computed_first,max(year) filter(where value_status='computed') computed_last from research.impact_visual_point group by model_key,baseline_year order by model_key,baseline_year
queries.group_samples: select series_key,group_key,min(group_label) group_label,count(*) n,min(year) first_year,max(year) last_year from public.indicator_values where series_key in ('statfin.12am.v20261019.eodote_0.sexSSS','safe_corridor.employment_rate_25_29') group by series_key,group_key order by series_key,group_key
queries.misc_schema: select table_name,string_agg(column_name,', ' order by ordinal_position) columns from information_schema.columns where table_schema='lakikartta' and table_name in ('state_enterprise_ownership','statute_catalog','societal_concept_coverage','societal_series_inventory') group by table_name
